**1B.8 Research Note: Andrés Manuel López Obrador in 2024**

I found **positive evidence of de-escalatory rhetoric and channel preservation**, but **no direct 2024 nuclear-crisis episode** where AMLO had to manage accidental war risk in an interstate confrontation. So the evidence is mostly inferential and diplomatic, not battlefield-level.

| Title | Publisher | Date | Recoverable page URL | Claim-level summary | Question IDs |
|---|---|---:|---|---|---|
| [“La política se inventó para evitar la guerra”, afirma presidente sobre conflicto en Medio Oriente](https://amlo.presidente.gob.mx/la-politica-se-invento-para-evitar-la-guerra-afirma-presidente-sobre-conflicto-en-medio-oriente/) | Presidente de México | 2024-04-13 | <https://amlo.presidente.gob.mx/la-politica-se-invento-para-evitar-la-guerra-afirma-presidente-sobre-conflicto-en-medio-oriente/> | AMLO said politics exists to avoid war, urged that the Iran-Israel conflict not escalate, described war as irrational and harmful, and called for peace and fraternity. This is the clearest direct 2024 evidence that he chose de-escalatory messaging in a live crisis. | 1B.8, 1B.2 |
| [Foreign Ministry prioritizes nuclear disarmament on Mexico’s international agenda](https://www.gob.mx/sre/prensa/foreign-ministry-prioritizes-nuclear-disarmament-on-mexico-s-international-agenda?idiom=en) | Secretaría de Relaciones Exteriores | 2024-02-14 | <https://www.gob.mx/sre/prensa/foreign-ministry-prioritizes-nuclear-disarmament-on-mexico-s-international-agenda?idiom=en> | Mexico framed its diplomacy around a safer world grounded in international law and cooperation rather than weapons. That supports a broader posture of keeping diplomatic channels open and reducing escalation incentives. | 1B.8, 1B.1, 1B.2, 1B.4 |
| [With World at Delicate Crossroads, Disarmament Committee’s Responsibility ‘Immense’, Says General Assembly President During Robust Debate](https://press.un.org/en/2024/gadis3737.doc.htm) | United Nations, Meetings Coverage and Press Releases | 2024-10-08 | <https://press.un.org/en/2024/gadis3737.doc.htm> | Mexico’s representative urged fewer warheads, progress on disarmament, and less rhetoric threatening nuclear use, and rejected the idea that nuclear weapons are part of the solution. This is direct evidence that Mexico used multilateral channels to reduce accident and escalation risk. | 1B.8, 1B.1, 1B.2, 1B.4 |
| [Mexico chairs OPANAL General Conference](https://www.gob.mx/sre/prensa/mexico-chairs-opanal-general-conference?idiom=en) | Secretaría de Relaciones Exteriores | 2024-11-28 | <https://www.gob.mx/sre/prensa/mexico-chairs-opanal-general-conference?idiom=en> | Mexico reaffirmed the Treaty of Tlatelolco and a world free of nuclear weapons while OPANAL participants reiterated disarmament and dialogue with nuclear-weapon states. This shows active maintenance of regional channels that reduce accidental war and preserve communication. | 1B.8, 1B.4, 1B.6, 1B.7 |
| [Communiqué of the Member States of OPANAL on the occasion of the 57th Anniversary of the Treaty of Tlatelolco](https://www.gob.mx/sre/prensa/communique-of-the-member-states-of-opanal-on-the-occasion-of-the-57th-anniversary-of-the-treaty-of-tlatelolco) | Secretaría de Relaciones Exteriores | 2024-02-14 | <https://www.gob.mx/sre/prensa/communique-of-the-member-states-of-opanal-on-the-occasion-of-the-57th-anniversary-of-the-treaty-of-tlatelolco> | OPANAL members, including Mexico, reaffirmed verifiable, irreversible, transparent disarmament under effective international control. This is evidence of institutional channels designed to reduce accidental war and preserve verification-based communication. | 1B.8, 1B.4, 1B.6, 1B.7 |

**What I did not find**

- No reliable 2024 source showing AMLO escalating a nuclear crisis, issuing reckless threats, or shutting down deconfliction channels.
- No Mexico-specific 2024 nuclear-accident crisis that would test accidental-war management directly.
- The strongest available evidence is therefore **de-escalatory rhetoric plus multilateral channel maintenance**, not a hard case of crisis bargaining.

**Bottom line**

- Best-supported reading: **yes, AMLO’s 2024 record shows de-escalation, clear communication, and channel-preserving behavior.**
- Confidence is moderate, because the evidence is **indirect** and mostly diplomatic rather than tied to a high-risk nuclear crisis.
